title.narrative: Increasing the resilience by strengthening Livelihoods and in Dar'a - Busra Esh-Sham for the most Vulnerable Populations

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project aims to enhance the resilience and well-being of vulnerable Syrian populations which is by livelihood support that will promote sustainable practices to protect and strengthen livelihoods disrupted by multiple crisis factors in Dar'a - Busra Esh-Sham. The targeted beneficiaries will target both Female heads of households, identified as one of the most vulnerable groups, constitute 11.95% of the families in the selected area. Lack of employment and low wages hinder the ability to meet basic needs and contribute to negative coping strategies, which can lead to sexual exploitation, especially for women and girls. The second group is men with physical disability that constitute of 0.6% of 8731 households.ltbrgtThe initiative offers training and resources to start or restart social or business entrepreneurship ventures, helping households strengthen livelihood strategies and avoid resorting to negative coping mechanisms. The project aims to enable SARC to reach 337 households (1685 people) through actions that support the labor integration of vulnerable populations. This will be achieved by providing basic business management skills training. Each 5-day training session for 20 participants will cover topics such as basic concepts, understanding the market, basic marketing skills, basic financial management skills, and business plan development. Upon completion of the training, participants will present their business plans to a committee established at the beginning of the project. beneficiaries will be accepted based on the evaluation of their proposed projects done by LLH committee that is implementing another project to ensure the transparency of the evaluation against pre-selected criteria. The final list of beneficiaries will be drawn up based on the results of the business plan evaluations and their competence in managing and initiate the project. ltbrgtThe selection criteria ensure that aid is directed to those most in need. The mandatory criteria:ltbrgt1. Women headed households or men with physical disability.ltbrgt2. Motivation and ability to workltbrgt3. Being above 18 years oldltbrgt4. Not having benefited from another livelihood programltbrgtThe conditional criteria:ltbrgt1. having young childrenltbrgt2. having a family member with a disability, ltbrgt3. prioritize families who face additional hardships.ltbrgtThe people assisted will be able to start a new livelihood activity or diversify their existing activities, contributing to securing their basic needs and improving their food availability and income. The modality of the interventions includes conditional grants provided in two tranches to ensure funds are used as per the approved business plan, Based on Focus Group discussion findings, the selected modality was cash, as the community preferred cash-based assistance over in-kind support. Additionally, the targeted population is familiar with and well-acquainted with the remittance companies available in the area.ltbrgtTo conclude, livelihood support intervention will offer holistic assistance that addresses both economic stability and the safety and empowerment of vulnerable populations in Syria. This approach ensures that while individuals and households work towards sustainable income generation, the community’s dignity is safeguarded. SARC is committed to ensuring that all its programs uphold the dignity and safety of the community, with livelihood support playing a crucial role in this commitment fostering a more resilient and empowered community.ltbrgtlt/pgt
